maddeler.e:
يتباهى (form VI)
# يَتَبَاهَى (yatabāhā) /ja.ta.baː.haː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَبَاهَى (tabāhā)
# يُتَبَاهَى (yutabāhā) /ju.ta.baː.haː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَبَاهَى (tabāhā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
